dish: chả ốc (snail-and-pork sausage rolls), ốc chả combo
w: The Eden Center specialist for chả ốc — Huế-style rolls of pork studded with snail for a clam-like snap, in a garlic-rich sauce — a dish you won't easily find elsewhere on the East Coast. Owner Huy Pham brought the Garden Grove, CA original east to the region's Little Saigon.

dish: chả lụa (pork sausage), chả chiên, chả quế (cinnamon pâté), bánh chưng
w: A take-out Eden Center institution and, per Arlington Magazine, "best of breed" for Vietnamese chả — house pork sausage (chả lụa), fried chả chiên and cinnamon chả quế, plus bánh bao and bánh chưng. A daily-staple counter for the local Vietnamese community.
